seoTitle: Square Footage Calculator - Find Area in Sq Ft
metaDescription: Free online Square Footage Calculator. Instantly calculate the area of any room or house in square feet. Handles complex shapes, rectangles, and circles.
intro: Laying carpet or listing a home for sale? Our free Square Footage Calculator instantly solves the area of any room, property, or object, converting your measurements into standard square feet.
whatIs: The Square Footage Calculator is a fundamental geometry tool used daily in real estate, construction, and interior design. It determines the two-dimensional area of a flat surface, acting as the baseline metric for pricing materials and property.
howToUse: Select the shape of the area you are measuring (Rectangle, Triangle, Circle).
Enter your measurements (Length and Width) in feet or inches.
The tool instantly multiplies the inputs and outputs the total square footage.
Add multiple areas together to find the total area of an entire house.
howItWorks: The tool converts all user inputs into decimal feet. For a rectangle, it multiplies Length × Width. For a triangle, it multiplies (Base × Height) / 2. For a circle, it uses the formula π × radius².
workedExample: You measure a bedroom that is 12 feet 6 inches long (12.5 ft) and 10 feet wide. 12.5 × 10 = 125. The room is exactly 125 square feet.
resultInterpretation: This number is the foundation of almost all home improvement projects. You use it to buy flooring, estimate HVAC cooling requirements, or price a home for the market.
useCases: Flooring Installation: Measuring a living room to determine how many boxes of laminate flooring to purchase.
Real Estate Listings: Calculating the total livable area of a house by measuring each individual room and summing the total.
Landscaping: Finding the square footage of a backyard to figure out how many rolls of grass sod to order.
tipsAndLimitations: If your room is L-shaped or highly irregular, simply break it down into smaller, standard rectangles, calculate the square footage of each, and add them together.
Square footage is a measurement of a flat 2D surface. If you need 3D volume (like for filling a pool), you must also multiply by depth.

faq.question: How do I convert inches to square feet?
faq.answer: First, calculate the square inches by multiplying length (in inches) by width (in inches). Then, divide that massive number by 144 (because one square foot is 12x12 inches).

faq.question: Do closets count toward house square footage?
faq.answer: Yes. In standard real estate appraisals, any finished, heated space (including closets and hallways) counts toward the gross living area.

disclaimer: Calculations are mathematically exact. When purchasing construction materials based on square footage, always add a 10% to 15% waste factor.
